CASE STUDY / MEDFLOW AI

Connected care.
Human-reviewed AI.

Healthcare revenue-cycle management with contextual AI assistance and role-based operational dashboards.

CHALLENGE

Connect enrollment, eligibility, authorization, claims and patient communication while retaining human review for business-critical actions.

APPROACH

Combined OCR extraction and RAG with LangChain and LangGraph workflows, prompt evaluation and review checkpoints.

SOLUTION

React interfaces, FastAPI and NestJS services, PostgreSQL and Redis, secured with JWT and role-based access controls.

CORE MODULES

Onboarding · Eligibility · Authorization · Claims · Provider review · Notifications
